name: Hai Van Pass
kicker: The coast pass between Da Nang and Hue
summary: Drive or ride the coast road over the pass north of the city on a clear day, when the road and the sea sit in one view. Allow half a day as a detour toward Hue. In cloud the sea disappears, so take the train instead, about three hours to Hue.
timeNeeded: Half a day as a detour
getThere: North from Da Nang by car or with a licensed rider.
heroCaption: The pass road, with the sea in the same frame

notice.title: Go only when the sky is clear
notice.body: Cloud hides the sea, which is the reason to take the pass. September to December is the heavy-rain and storm window. The train skips the pass.

body: Hai Van is the coast road north, between Da Nang and Hue. Go by car or with a licensed rider, and only on a clear day. You want the road and the sea in one view. It is a detour, not a city sight, and not a required stop on the way to the airport.
The road has no ticket. Ask the price of any tunnel toll or rider hire before you set off.

If the sky is wrong, take the train. SE3 leaves Hue at 07:55 and reaches Da Nang at 10:43, about three hours, and the rail line does not climb the pass. In cloud the road is still there and the sea is not. That is the day to skip.

figures.caption: The same road in cloud, with the sea missing. Skip this day.
figures.alt: Hai Van Pass in cloud, the road visible and the sea hidden

gettingThere: The pass is north of Da Nang, on the coast road toward Hue. Go by car or with a licensed rider. The train is the alternative.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: North by car or a licensed rider, in clear weather.

legs.heading: If you skip the pass
legs.body: The train between Hue and Da Nang takes about three hours on the SE3 times, Hue 07:55 to Da Nang 10:43. Other trains differ, and the timetable changes.

hours: Daylight, and only when the sky is clear. No gate. Drive time over the pass: check on arrival.
closed: Do not ride it in cloud. September to December is the heavy-rain and storm window.
admissionNote: No road ticket. Tunnel fees and rider hire: check on arrival.
